items.name: set_default
items.signature: fn set_default<S>(subscriber: S) -> DefaultGuard where S: Subscriber + Send + Sync + 'static
items.summary: Sets the [`Subscriber`] as the default for the current thread for the duration of the lifetime of the returned [`DefaultGuard`].

items.name: set_global_default
items.signature: fn set_global_default<S>(subscriber: S) -> Result<(), SetGlobalDefaultError> where S: Subscriber + Send + Sync + 'static
items.summary: Sets this subscriber as the global default for the duration of the entire program. Will be used as a fallback if no thread-local subscriber has been set in a thread (using `with_default`.)

items.name: with_default
items.signature: fn with_default<T, S>(subscriber: S, f: impl FnOnce() -> T) -> T where S: Subscriber + Send + Sync + 'static
items.summary: Sets this [`Subscriber`] as the default for the current thread for the duration of a closure.
